name: Light Sea Green
lede: Light sea green is a web color, a cool teal-green from the X11 set, that is actually fairly dark for a name that says light.

sections.title: What the name means
sections.body:
Paterson lists *LightSeaGreen* as another color in the X11 Color Set, with the hex code #20B2AA [1]. It is a web color first, built from the base word [[sea-green]] [1]. The swatch is a medium teal, and the nearest ISCC-NBS name is light bluish green [2]. A competing swatch in our library, from the xkcd color survey, is a much paler mint, #98F6B0, so the name does not point to one color [2]. Neighbors are [[turquoise]], [[teal]] and [[aquamarine]] [2]. Like every web color it is defined by a hex code, so the swatch is a screen approximation and not a dye or a paint [2]. Nothing in our books ties it to a pigment or a historical source [1].

The books give no history for the name beyond the color list, so none is claimed [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Light sea green is almost absent from painting. Only 3 of the 23,781 paintings in our archive hold a color near this swatch, as photographed [3].

origin.named_after: the color of the sea, lightened
